approved.en: Ukraine deployed a drone to airlift a wounded soldier from the front line, a first-of-its-kind operation. Russian drones killed children and an infant in a park in Kharkiv Oblast. The US delayed delivery of Patriot interceptor missiles to Ukraine, and Trump signed an executive order waiving a new Russia sanctions package, prompting Zelenskyy to accuse him of rewarding Putin. 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA forsinket leveringen av Patriot-interseptormissiler til Ukraina, og Trump signerte en eksekutiv ordre som frafalt en ny sanksjonspakke mot Russland, noe som fikk Zelenskyj til å anklage ham for å belønne Putin. 75 767 kamprelaterte dødsfall fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli police have detained ten settlers suspected of attacking a US photographer, a French mayor and other civilians in the West Bank, torching cars and olive trees and wounding farmers. The World Food Programme is ending food aid for half a million people in Gaza because of funding shortfalls, while UNICEF reports that 340 children have been killed despite a ceasefire. Israel is resuming entry of private-sector goods into Gaza, where five people have been reported killed. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Verdens matprogram avslutter matstøtte til en halv million mennesker i Gaza på grunn av finansielle mangler, mens UNICEF rapporterer at 340 barn er drept til tross for en våpenhvile. Israel gjenopptar innføringen av private varer til Gaza, hvor fem personer er rapportert drept. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. approved.en: Iran has intensified its maritime campaign, attacking container ships in the Strait of Hormuz, striking a tug there, and launching missiles near the UAE while its IRGC conducts drone and artillery strikes in Iraqi Kurdistan after installing a new defence minister. Tehran has urged the reopening of the strait and Lavrov visited Tehran, publicly backing Iran amid questions about Moscow’s role. Houthi forces have repeatedly struck Yemeni army and government training camps, killing dozens of recruits in Shabwa and elsewhere. Pakistan has suspended border trade with Iran following cross-border violence. 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Teheran har oppfordret til at sundet åpnes igjen, og Lavrov besøkte Teheran og ga offentlig støtte til Iran til tross for spørsmål om Moskvas rolle. Houthiene har gjentatte ganger angrepet jemenittiske hær‑ og regjerings-treningsleirer, og drept dusinvis av rekrutter i Shabwa og andre steder. Pakistan har stanset grensehandelen med Iran etter vold over grensen. 123 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces have intensified attacks on Saudi-backed Yemeni army training camps, striking a camp in Shabwa and killing more than 50 soldiers. The surge of missile and ballistic strikes prompted Saudi Arabia to postpone the planned “Davos in the desert” summit and to send its skyscraper employees home due to heightened threats. These actions follow a series of recent Houthi attacks that have caused the highest single loss of life since the civil war resumed. The war produced 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Disse handlingene følger en rekke nylige houthi-angrep som har ført til det høyeste enkeltantallet døde siden borgerkrigen startet igjen. Krigen førte til 918 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The Shingal mayoral post, vacant for nine years, is now open for nominations, and Jordan's king reaffirmed support for regional sovereignty and security. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: The Sudanese army and Rapid Support Forces are intensifying drone strikes on civilian sites, including a livestock market in Khartoum, a market where 80 people were killed, and gold-mining areas in West Kordofan and near the Egypt border, causing dozens of civilian deaths. Recent attacks have also hit a market in southern Sudan and an artisanal gold mine in South Kordofan, killing children and many civilians. These strikes expand the use of drones from combatant targets to economic and civilian locations, increasing civilian casualties. The conflict remains between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Den sudanske hæren og RSF-militsen intensiverer droneangrep på sivile mål, inkludert et husdyrmarked i Khartoum, et marked hvor 80 personer ble drept, og gullgruveområder i Vest-Kordofan og nær grensen mot Egypt, noe som har ført til dusinvis av sivile dødsfall. Nylige angrep har også rammet et marked i sørlige Sudan og en håndverksgullgruve i Sør-Kordofan, der barn og mange sivile ble drept. Disse angrepene utvider bruken av droner fra stridende mål til økonomiske og sivile steder, og øker antallet sivile ofre. Konflikten vedvarer mellom den sudanske hæren (SAF) og RSF-militsen. 4 680 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Sudanese armed forces carried out a drone strike on Abyei’s Amiet market, killing dozens and injuring many, prompting South Sudan to summon Sudan’s envoy over the attack. A separate drone strike in the disputed Sudan-South Sudan border region also caused high casualties. In Ruweng, fresh attacks left nine dead and six wounded, while in Northern Bahr el Ghazal bodies arrived from Khor Kaltan killings. Communal clashes continued, including 14 deaths between Warrap and Lakes communities and a traditional chief’s arrest over a Juba youth killing. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Den sudanske hæren utførte et droneangrep på Amiet-markedet i Abyei, der drepte dusinvis og såret mange, og fikk Sør-Sudan til å innkalle Sudans sendebud over angrepet. Et separat droneangrep i det omstridte grenseområdet mellom Sudan og Sør-Sudan forårsaket også høye tap. I Ruweng førte nye angrep til ni døde og seks sårede, mens i Nord-Bahr el Ghazal ankom lik fra drapene i Khor Kaltan. Kommunale sammenstøt fortsatte, inkludert 14 dødsfall mellom Warrap‑ og Lakes-samfunnene og arrestasjonen av en tradisjonell høvding over et drap på en ungdom i Juba. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have installed a caretaker administration in Tigray and are advancing toward the Eritrean border, while a pro-government militia says it has seized the regional airport and reports Eritrean forces suffered losses there. The United States, through Secretary of State Marco Rubio, is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate the fighting. Mekelle mayor Shishay Amare announced that elections will be held within six months and that Western Tigray will be settled through constitutional processes. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA, gjennom utenriksminister Marco Rubio, oppfordrer Etiopia og Eritrea til å dempe kampene. Ordfører i Mekelle, Shishay Amare, kunngjorde at valg vil bli holdt innen seks måneder og at Vest-Tigray vil bli løst gjennom konstitusjonelle prosesser. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharan forces now hold the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia announced the withdrawal of more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as its own civil war intensifies, and Ethiopia has refused to intervene in the South West State conflict. Somaliland and Puntland were designated as "friendly" in an Israeli security framework, and Somalia is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case and has agreed to acquire Pakistani JF‑17 fighter jets. The UCDP recorded 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
